description.text: Major Courses: Operational Research, Accounting, Management Science, Management Economics, Enterprise Management, Management Information System, E-Business, Logistics Management, Highway & Bridge Technique, Technical Economics, Project Management, Project Tender & Bid, Construction Cost Management, Investment & Decision Analysis, Principle & Method on Feasibility Research, Project Risk Management, etc. Employment Prospect: Project exploitation and investment analysis; e-business; logistics management; project construction cost control and management; industrial and commercial enterprise management; project management; bidding; modern enterprise decision-making and management; project budget estimate and construction cost management; project investment; financing; risk management; teaching and scientific research in these fields.

duration.text: The Business Administration at Chongqing Jiaotong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Certification of no criminal record 8. Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: Non-Chinese, under 30 years old, good scores in high school, passed HSK 4
